topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I walked into the lobby today, and there it was—a notice, crisp and official, pinned to the board. The building is going condo. The words didn’t sting as I thought they might. Instead, they felt like a gentle shift, like the slow turning of the seasons. I imagined the hallways transforming, each door a portal to someone’s new beginning, the hum of the old radiators replaced by the quiet of new lives. The familiar creaks and whispers of the place will fade, but that’s the way of things, isn’t it? I walked back to my apartment, the air feeling a little lighter, thinking about the fresh coat of paint and the futures that will unfold here.
